title: A generalization of the Erdős-Sierpiński conjecture
summary: In this paper, we investigate the combinatorial structure and asymptotic distribution of the solution set of the equation $σ(n+1) = kσ(n)$ for a given integer $k>1$. From a combinatorial perspective, the solutions to this equation are closely related to the concept of $k$-layered numbers, which are a generalization of Zumkeller numbers. In the analytic section, which constitutes the core of this research, we employ the framework of probabilistic number theory and an extension of the classical Kubilius model to study the oscillatory and local behavior of the sum-of-divisors function.…
